Has a spread radius of 15. |ability2_cooldown = 30 |ability2_attack_cooldown = 3 }} ==Description== The '''Painter''' was an enemy that is an enemy that appeared in [[The Narratorium]] as a part of [[The Final Act Event]]. It had a decently high amount of health and an average speed. The '''Painter''' has two abilities. The first ability is ''Summon'', which makes it summon different enemies. These enemies can be [[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] (60% chance), [[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]] (30% chance) and [[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] (10% chance). The second ability is ''Paint Splatter'' which makes it splatter paint on a tower, which on impact causes it to fly in four different directions, creating a cross. Any tower hit will receive a 33% [[Scared Debuff]] for 8 seconds, while units receive 1,600 damage. This ability has a spread radius of 15. ==Logbook Description== "''The Painters are known for being the actual legends in their field. When they are around, things just become cooler. The Producer would run to Narrator and tell him, 'Honey, we have guests. Bring out the fine paintings.'''" ==Appearance== The '''Painter''' is an object-headed robot with an easel for a head. This easel has a canvas with three possible faces that can appear. It has a grey body, green shirt, blue pants, grey shoes and a black vest. It has two paint cans on its back and a paint brush in its right hand. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] is listed instead. *Due to their late debut, '''Painters''' usually are not all too threatening with their relatively slow speed. However, be aware of the various actors they summon through their ''Summon'' ability. **As one of the Actors summoned has [[Splash Damage Immunity]], explosive towers are not always the best choice, though are still quite effective. *While usually not problematic, '''Painters''' still have decently high health and appear in small groups, so your typical high damage towers will have to deal with them. **[[Accelerator]], [[Golden Minigunner]], and [[Ranger]] are all more than enough to handle them alone, especially when paired with other towers or each other. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpsePainter.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (20 December 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} PainterIconIG.png|'''Painter''' on its [[Index]] icon. ManFace.png|'''Painter’s''' face. WomanFace.png|'''Painter’s''' face. WinningSmile.png|'''Painter’s''' face. }} ==Trivia== *The final sentence of the [[Logbooks|Logbook]] description is a [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/bring-out-the-fine-china bring out the fine china] meme. **The faces seen on the enemy are also used on a version of this meme containing mugs and plates containing these three faces, meaning these two references are likely connected. *All the faces the '''Painter''' can have are Roblox faces which became memes. These can be the {{RLinkC|616380929|The Winning Smile}}, {{RLinkC|86487700|Man Face}} and {{RLinkC|86487766|Woman Face}} *In the [[Spotlight (Enemy)|Spotlight]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] entry, they are referred to as the ''Painter Men''. ==Update History== *'''20 December 2025''' - [[v1.83.0]]a **'''Painter''' added. *'''11 March 2026''' - [[v1.86.0]] **'''Painter''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{TheNarratorium|[[Projector]]|Wave 26|Painter|Wave 28|[[Narrator (Enemy)|Narrator]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
